headline: Rain forecast: Rain likely across country for next 5 days
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department predicts moderate to very heavy rainfall across most divisions, driven by active monsoon winds in the north.
details: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has forecasted a trend of rainfall across the country for the next five days.

Heavy rain is expected across Bangladesh for the next five days.

The Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) has forecasted a trend of rainfall across the country for the next five days.

According to meteorologist Dr. Md. Omar Faruq, the monsoon wind's axis is currently extended from Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and northern Bangladesh to Assam.

Rainfall is expected in most parts of Rajshahi, Rangpur, Dhaka, Mymensingh, Barishal, Chattogram, and Sylhet divisions, as well as many parts of the Khulna division.

The BMD warns that some areas may experience moderate to very heavy rainfall accompanied by temporary gusty winds.

The monsoon remains active in the northern regions of the country, while it is moderately active elsewhere and in a medium state in the North Bay of Bengal.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune

headline: Tuesday alert: Gas supply to remain suspended in several Dhaka areas
summary: Residents in multiple parts of the capital city will face gas outages on Tuesday.
details: Gas supply will remain suspended in several areas of Dhaka on Tuesday.
The suspension is part of scheduled maintenance or operational adjustments in the city's gas network.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to make necessary arrangements for their daily needs.
The authorities have not specified the exact duration of the outage for each specific neighborhood.
